title: Lender Preflight Coordination
name: Lender Preflight Coordination
metaTitle: Lender Preflight Coordination in Dallas, TX
metaDescription: Getting financing pre-underwriting moving well before a Dallas 1031 deadline arrives, so the replacement closing never becomes the exchange's bottleneck.

sections.html: A 1031 exchange's tightest constraint in practice is usually not finding a suitable Dallas replacement property, it is getting a lender to move fast enough to actually close on it before day 180 arrives. Preflight coordination means starting the financing conversation before a property is even identified, so underwriting is already in motion once a candidate firms up rather than starting cold with 40 days left. Waiting until a property is identified to start this conversation is one of the more avoidable ways an otherwise sound exchange runs out of runway, and it is avoidable precisely because so much of the borrower-side underwriting does not actually depend on knowing the property yet.

sections.heading: Why Lenders Do Not Naturally Move at Exchange-Deadline Speed
sections.html: Commercial lenders underwrite on their own schedule, appraisal orders, environmental review, title work, none of which is designed with a borrower's tax deadline in mind. A loan that might comfortably close in 60 or 75 days under normal circumstances becomes a serious risk to an exchange if the borrower does not start the conversation until after identification, with barely 100 days left on the 180-day clock. Preflight work exists to compress that gap before it becomes a problem, and the compression only works if it starts while the relinquished sale is still in process rather than after it closes. Waiting until identification is complete to have this conversation treats the lender as an afterthought instead of a party whose timeline can make or break the entire exchange.

sections.heading: What Gets Done Before Any Specific Property Is Even Named
sections.html: Before a specific Dallas replacement is identified, a lender can still review the borrower's financial statements, entity structure, and general loan parameters, leverage target, rate expectations, recourse or non-recourse terms, based on the general asset classes under active consideration. Getting this preliminary underwriting done during the relinquished property's own closing process, rather than waiting for identification, means the lender only needs property-specific details once a candidate is named, not a full underwriting file started from scratch. That head start alone can be the difference between a replacement closing that comfortably beats day 180 and one that arrives with days to spare.

sections.heading: Matching Debt Replacement to the Boot Calculation
sections.html: Financing on the replacement property also has to line up with the debt payoff on the relinquished sale to avoid triggering mortgage boot. If an investor is retiring debt on a Preston Center-area office and moving into a suburban NNN parcel or an industrial building near I-20, the lender needs to know the target loan amount early enough to structure terms that either match or exceed the debt being replaced, rather than discovering a shortfall once the replacement is already under contract. A shortfall found this late usually forces a choice between adding cash the investor had not planned to contribute or accepting mortgage boot as a taxable outcome, neither of which is a decision worth making under time pressure at the closing table.

sections.heading: What a Preflight Checklist Covers
sections.html:
Before identification closes, lender preflight coordination typically confirms:

  • Preliminary underwriting on borrower financials and entity structure, independent of a specific property
  • Target loan amount matched against debt relief from the relinquished sale
  • Appraisal and environmental turnaround times for likely asset classes under consideration
  • Rate lock and commitment timeline mapped against the replacement closing date
  • Documentation the lender will require once a specific property is identified

sections.heading: Where This Breaks Down Without Early Coordination
sections.html: The most common failure point is an investor who identifies a strong Dallas replacement candidate on day 40 and only then approaches a lender for the first time, leaving underwriting, appraisal, and closing to happen inside the remaining 140 days with no preliminary work done at all. Preflight coordination front-loads as much of that process as possible into the period before identification, so the lender's remaining work once a property is named is genuinely property-specific rather than starting from zero. That difference alone can be enough to turn a lender who might otherwise have needed 90 days into one who can realistically close inside 60, which matters enormously when the exchange window is fixed and unforgiving.

faqs.q: Can I get pre-underwritten before I know which property I am buying?
faqs.a: Yes, at least partially. A lender can review financial statements, entity structure, and general loan parameters ahead of a specific property, which shortens the remaining work once a candidate is identified and reduces the risk of the loan becoming the exchange's bottleneck.

faqs.q: What if my target lender cannot close before day 180?
faqs.a: This is exactly what preflight coordination is meant to catch early. If a lender's typical timeline does not fit the remaining exchange window, the options at that point are a different lender with a demonstrably faster process, an all-cash close with financing added afterward, or reconsidering the replacement property itself before it is too late to pivot.

faqs.q: Does replacing less debt than I paid off create a problem?
faqs.a: It can trigger mortgage boot, a taxable event, unless offset with additional cash into the replacement purchase. Confirming the target loan amount early, before a property is under contract, gives more room to adjust either the financing or the offer before this becomes an issue.

faqs.q: How early is too early to start talking to a lender?
faqs.a: Generally not too early at all. Starting preliminary conversations during the relinquished property's own closing process, well before identification, is the point of preflight coordination rather than something to delay until a specific replacement is chosen.
